body: Una600 ADMITTED for scope: MAINLINE-002 strength card (ESTIMATE_PENDING_UNA), six rows P1/P2/P3 + P1-A/P2-A/P3-A (UNA600-MAINLINE002-REVIEW.md). SCOPE, the CO's: arithmetic from the stated inputs and the presence of every QUESTIONABLE tag and source. PINS: order 5/5, owner manifest 24/24 (the four baseline files included). METHOD: my own ordinary arithmetic (mycheck2.py) from the pinned baseline INPUTS, the 276 MPa premise and the card's stated models; the owner's arithmetic.py and the predecessor checkers were not run. ARITHMETIC: 97 RESULTS.json numbers agree at relative 1e-12 (ISA 500 m, V and lift; masses and totals; float margins; every stated limit: knocked-down buckling or pinned Euler, aluminium yield 2st/R, 4s*tf/R and 2sA/(Rs), the film membrane; governing least limit; collapse; crush SF; each factor = p_ext/limit; each stiffness-only remaining SF = min(1, least non-stiffness limit/p_ext)). The allocation thicknesses P1-A t, P2-A tf and P3-A tw match my closed forms; their residual margins (1.86e-16, 0, 3.72e-16) are numerical zero, not reserve. All 71 of my values at 12 significant digits appear in CARD.md. TAGS/SOURCES: the 276 MPa premise is tagged QUESTIONABLE with its source present (tensile_yield_typical, TRANSFERRED_FROM_TENSILE_YIELD, admitted false; gap NFI-AL-YIELD-CARRY); baseline inputs 35/35 tagged and sourced; current NFI 8/8 and pinned baseline NFI 11/11 complete. QUALIFICATIONS CARRIED: (1) 276 MPa is preserved as the owner-reported typical TENSILE yield transferred to compression by assumption, with no raw source capture, compressive-value admission or property certification; (2) no physical-model or construction-safety certification: the least modeled limit omits shear, wrinkling, core crush, crippling and fabrication; the alternatives are allocations, not optima; the factors are single-property multipliers; the film limit is separate from aluminium; (3) the owner's phase-4 breach stands, 328.744 s against 165, over by 163.7440369010437 s, uncured by whole-budget headroom; the CO's accounting disposition is separate and this review does not authorize it. MY CLOCK: origin 2026-10-20T03:45:12.229308Z; phase 1 88.204 s of 400; phase 2 42.512 s of 165; actual 130.716 s of 565; charged 165.716 s with the 10 + 25 allowances; retired 434.284 s of 600; final 2026-10-20T03:47:22.945121+00:00; the publication sample in PUBLICATION.json; the ledger in final-ledger.json.
